shortDescription: This module configures and manages replication policies on IBM Storage Virtualize family systems

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP or Partition IP of the Storage Virtualize system.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Storage Virtualize system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: ha_snapshots
options.description: When specified as I(yes), snapshots created for volumes and volume groups associated with the policy will be replicated to the remote system. Applies when I(state=present) and I(topology=2-site-ha). Supported from Storage Virtualize family systems 8.7.3.0 or later.

options.name: location1iogrp
options.description: Specifies the ID of the I/O group of the system in location 1 of the topology.

options.name: location1system
options.description: Specifies the name or ID of the system in location 1 of the topology.

options.name: location2iogrp
options.description: Specifies the ID of the I/O group of the system in location 2 of the topology.

options.name: location2system
options.description: Specifies the name or ID of the system in location 2 of the topology.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name or UUID of the replication policy.

options.name: partition
options.description: Specifies the name or UUID of the storage partition to be assigned to async-dr replication policy. Applies when I(state=present). Supported from Storage Virtualize family systems 8.7.1.0 or later.

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: rpoalert
options.description: Specifies the RPO alert threshold in seconds. The minimum value is 60 (1 minute) and the maximum value is 86400 (1 day). The value must be a multiple of 60 seconds.

options.name: state
options.description: Creates, updates (C(present)), or deletes (C(absent)) a replication policy.

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Storage Virtualize system. To generate a token, use the M(ibm.storage_virtualize.ibm_svc_auth) module.

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.
